newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close mixed, index slips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close mixed, index slips.

text.p: Dhaka stocks end mixed lower as some blue chip shares fell on profit-taking, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 5.19 points or 0.27 percent to 1,874.39, on turnover of 56.6 million taka on Saturday. Of 83 traded issues, 52 gained and 28 lost. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
"The prices of few of the weighted shares have pulled down the index. There is nothing to worry about the market at the moment. It has almost stabilised," said a broker.
Leasing company IDLC gained 178 taka to 4,286, Apex Foods lost 772 to 6,948 and United Insurance shed 50 to 500.
